fas_key.description: Pre-shared encryption key between openNDS and FAS script (must match openNDS faskey config).

fas_sessionlength.description: Session length in minutes (0 = no limit).

fas_uploadrate.description: Client upload rate limit in kbits/sec (0 = no limit).

fas_downloadrate.description: Client download rate limit in kbits/sec (0 = no limit).

fas_uploadquota.description: Client upload quota in kBytes (0 = no limit).

fas_downloadquota.description: Client download quota in kBytes (0 = no limit).

fas_imageurl.description: URL of the image to display on the splash page.
